text:
tara (PM): Pushing a small design review: updated Invite + Roles panel in Figma. Goal: make dense role management usable without hiding actions. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/unique1. Quick asks: prefer micro-kebab vs inline buttons in compact rows, SSO toggle placement (banner vs settings), and a fast path to audit entries (Audit Finder). Please flag blockers.

kai (Designer): Uploaded dense frames (6 rows visible). Kept action affordance as a low-contrast, always-visible micro-kebab on the right. Hover-only felt too hidden in research.

miguel (Frontend): Good call. Hover-only causes reflow on Safari. Micro-kebab simplifies layout. Note: ensure touch targets are 44px and don't collapse row height on mobile.

anya (Eng-ML): Accessibility: micro-kebab must be a button with aria-label: "Row actions for <name>". Role chips should expose state via aria-pressed or aria-selected and readable text like "Role: Billing Admin, assigned".

rachel (Support): From recent tickets customers ask where audit logs went after UI changes. Suggest a header-level Audit icon that opens the Audit Finder and optional timestamp anchors in rows.

kai (Designer): I can add a subtle link icon beside timestamps that opens the Audit Finder anchored to that event; will also show a header Audit button.

miguel (Frontend): Timestamp anchor can be implemented as /orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_123 with a graceful fallback if audit isn't provisioned (show tooltip: "Audit not enabled"). I'll prototype spike tomorrow.

a11y-bot: Quick checklist: 1) micro-kebab = keyboard focusable + aria-expanded state. 2) roles grid must be semantic (table or labeled list). 3) focus order: org selector -> invite button -> roles matrix -> audit quicklink. 4) Audit Finder modal needs role="dialog", labelledby, and focus trap. 5) provide skip links for long org lists.

anya (Eng-ML): Also insist on visible focus ring on compressed rows  current mock hides outlines. That will block keyboard users.

tara (PM): Copy suggestions: change "Invite team" -> "Invite people" and SSO label to "Enforce SSO sign-in". Will we need helper text under the toggle?

kai (Designer): "Invite people" works. For SSO label I'll show a short label with a micro-help line beneath to avoid breaking the header.

miguel (Frontend): We'll wire `aria-describedby` to expose the helper text to screen readers without cluttering UI.

rachel (Support): I'll draft KB for the new label and Audit Finder flows once copy is final. Include note about API/service account impacts.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run Axe and VoiceOver checks before sign-off, include aria attributes in the PR.

tara (PM): Next steps: kai update Figma with micro-kebab + timestamp anchor; miguel spike anchor + fallback + touch sizing; anya run keyboard/SR pass; rachel draft KB. Sync Friday AM?

kai (Designer): 👍 will post new frames and call out density tradeoffs.

miguel (Frontend): starting spike tomorrow, will report issues (esp Safari).

anya (Eng-ML): will run NVDA/VoiceOver tests and post a short issue list.

a11y-bot: Don't forget to include aria-labels and test focus management in the PR description.

tara (PM): thanks everyone! Adding action items to the board.
